description: This file implements a Python code linter class 'DocstringLinter' that checks for long functions, methods, or classes without proper docstrings, and manages grandfathered exceptions. It includes methods for linting, reporting, and configuration, and uses external modules and files for its operation.

classes.name: DocstringLinter
classes.description: A linter class that checks for long functions, methods, or classes without docstrings and manages grandfathered exceptions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the linter, sets up data structures, and adds command-line arguments.

methods.name: lint_all
methods.description: Runs the linting process on all files and generates reports.

methods.name: _lint
methods.description: Performs linting on a specific Python file, identifying bad blocks.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Records linting errors for a specific file.

methods.name: _grandfather
methods.description: Loads the grandfather list from a JSON file.

methods.name: _max_lines
methods.description: Returns maximum line limits for classes and functions.

methods.name: _grandfathered
methods.description: Determines if a block is grandfathered based on size and tolerance.

methods.name: _block_result
methods.description: Generates a lint result message for a block.

methods.name: _display
methods.description: Displays lint results if reporting is enabled.

methods.name: _dont_require_constructor_and_class_docs
methods.description: Adjusts bad blocks to ignore missing constructor or class docstrings based on configuration.

methods.name: _is_bad_block
methods.description: Determines if a code block is considered bad based on size and docstring length.

methods.name: _report
methods.description: Generates and prints a report of linting results.

methods.name: _write_grandfather
methods.description: Writes the current bad blocks to the grandfather JSON file.
